That night, the beam swept the black water like a slow, steady heartbeat, as if answering a greeting sent across many silent years.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的梦里。路灯把湿漉漉的街道照成安静的河，偶尔有出租车驶过，尾灯在薄雾里留下短暂的红光。高楼的窗大多黑着，只有便利店仍亮着温暖的白。早点铺升起蒸汽，案板轻响，环卫工扫过落叶与碎纸。街角海棠静静开着，露珠凝在花瓣边缘。没有人潮，没有喇叭，城市像一艘缓缓靠岸的船，把醒着的人温柔托在掌心。","w03":"- Think of recursion as asking a smaller copy of yourself to help with the same problem.\n- That smaller copy asks another even smaller copy, until the task becomes simple enough to answer immediately.\n- Then each answer is passed back up, one copy at a time, until the original problem is solved."}
